component.name: Porog
component.summary: The way back into the Fond suite

description.p: Porog (порог — Russian for "threshold") is one quiet window for the Fond suite: Sputnik, Pereplyot, Kartoteka, Zerkalo and Skrizhal. Each app has a row that is always in the same place, and opens from there.

ul.li: A fixed row for each Fond app, which says plainly when an app is not installed.
Fully usable from the keyboard: arrow keys and Enter, or Alt+1 to Alt+5.
Nothing on screen changes while you are looking at it.
Resume: what you were last doing in each app, with a button that reopens it.
Today: Sputnik's Now card at the top, in Sputnik's own words.
Ctrl+K searches all five apps at once.

description.p: 0.2.0 "Wide Threshold" — Ctrl+K now searches every Fond app, not just Kartoteka: class notes and materials in Sputnik, documents and annotations in Pereplyot, .typ files in Zerkalo and CV entries in Skrizhal. Needs each app's current release.

0.1.0 "Open Door" — the first release. One window with a fixed row for each Fond app, what you were last doing in each with a Resume button, Sputnik's Now card, and Ctrl+K search of your Kartoteka library.
